title: Copilot review workflow: marking a draft PR ready fails with 'Resource not accessible by integration' under pull-requests: write alone
answers: Copilot review workflow fails to mark draft PR ready for review
Resource not accessible by integration markPullRequestReadyForReview
gh pr ready fails in GitHub Actions copilot review
draft PR never gets Copilot review requested
body:
Symptom: The Copilot review workflow fails at the 'Mark ready for review' step, so the follow-up Copilot review request never runs. Error: 'GraphQL: Resource not accessible by integration (markPullRequestReadyForReview)'.
Root cause: not confirmed. Reviewers observed the failure with `pull-requests: write` alone (run 33641318507, attempt 2, on #25537). Adding `contents: write` was proposed as the fix, but a reviewer argued the mutation is covered by `pull-requests: write` and `contents` does not authorize it.
Fix pattern: not established by PR #25538. The reviewer asked to remove the `contents: write` addition and diagnose the failing token scope from a run log before changing permissions.
Constraints: Applies to the `request-review` job permissions in .github/workflows/copilot-review.yml, which runs on `pull_request_target`. Do not widen the token to `contents: write` (branches, tags, releases) without evidence from a failing run.
applies: Only the permissions block of the request-review job in .github/workflows/copilot-review.yml; verify with a real run before relying on any scope change.
says: The automated reviewer fails when attempting to mark a draft pull request as ready.
Draft pull requests get stuck and never receive an automated Copilot code review.
The bot reports an integration access error when transitioning a pull request from draft.
Pull requests cannot be automatically marked ready for review due to insufficient permissions.
Enable automated review requests to proceed after marking draft pull requests ready for review.

Although adding contents: write was proposed, reviewers noted the mutation is covered by pull-requests: write and left the root cause and fix pattern unconfirmed. Do not widen token permissions to contents: write (branches, tags, releases) without diagnosing the failing token scope from run logs.
